design_system_injection.custom_css: :root { --bg: #030711; --surface: #0D1626; --surface-alt: #17243A; --text: #ECFEFF; --muted: #A8C2CC; --primary: #00A3B5; --accent: #FBBF24; --on-primary: #000000; --on-accent: #000000; --border: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 14%, transparent); --grid-line: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 8%, transparent); --radius: 40px; --gap: 24px; --blur: 18px; --nav-position: sticky; --shadow: 0 24px 70px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 13%, transparent); --shadow-strong: 0 36px 100px color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 20%, transparent); } body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font-family: 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; } h1,h2,h3,.display { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; } .local-map-panel { display: grid; grid-template-columns: .9fr 1.1fr; gap: var(--gap); align-items: stretch; } .area-chip { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 999px; padding: .75rem 1rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 88%, var(--accent)); } .trust-badge { backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur)); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 88%, transparent); }  @media (max-width: 760px) { .hero, .hero--bento, .local-map-panel, .editorial-flow { grid-template-columns: 1fr; min-height: auto; } .proof-strip { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }
